description: This file contains the implementation of a SQLite driver for the Notesnook project, including connection management, transaction handling, and query execution using react-native-quick-sqlite and Kysely.

classes.name: RNSqliteDriver
classes.description: Implements the Driver interface to manage SQLite connections, transactions, and queries in a React Native environment.

classes.name: ConnectionMutex
classes.description: Provides a mutex mechanism to ensure single connection access in SQLite.

classes.name: RNSqliteConnection
classes.description: Represents a database connection, executing queries and handling query modes.

methods.name: acquireConnection
methods.description: Acquires the database connection, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the mutex to ensure exclusive access.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the mutex to allow other access.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Executes a compiled SQL query and returns the result.
